subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried is still serving his 25-year sentence.

summary: The verdict is TRUE: as of 2026-07-01 Sam Bankman‑Fried is still serving his 25‑year sentence. Decisive facts: he was sentenced to 25 years on 2024‑03‑28 and began serving immediately; no pardon or commutation has been granted (pardon request pending as of 2026‑07‑13); multiple sources confirm he remained incarcerated through mid‑2026, with Senate resolutions opposing clemency and a pardon request still pending.

findings.statement: Samuel Benjamin Bankman-Fried (born March 5, 1992) is the full legal name and date of birth of the individual known as Sam Bankman-Fried.
On March 28, 2024, Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison and began serving that sentence immediately thereafter.
As of July 1, 2026, Sam Bankman-Fried remains incarcerated serving his 25-year sentence, with no pardon or commutation granted.
